evidence: The sleep and pressure app manifests register these page descriptors. Their create and destroy paths assign and clear the state slots audited separately. The HRV detail uses separate distribution and trend builders; distribution can open the information page. Explanation and information builders select distinct localized strings. Pressure measurement builds preparation UI and later countdown callback builds the measuring state. Pressure month chart builds date labels, an average and a draw event callback.
scope: Recorded shared UI calls only. HRV data interpretation, pressure measurement, storage and other rendering paths remain outside these named points.
limitations: Changing health status or chart labels may misrepresent actual data. Callback modification can affect page behavior. Text and image resources must remain valid. State slots do not provide a thread barrier; device behavior and recovery remain unverified.
